slides.unit: questions to ask before you join a startup
slides.sub: Ask them before you sign. Save this for your next final round.

slides.title: How long is your runway?
slides.sub: Ask in months, not "we're well funded". Then ask what happens if the next raise slips. Good founders have already planned for it.

slides.title: Why is this role open now?
options: It's new: what changed to create it?
It's a backfill: what happened last time?
slides.sub: Either answer is fine. A vague one isn't.

slides.title: What does success look like by then?
slides.sub: If nobody can describe it, the role isn't defined yet. That can be an opportunity, as long as you know it going in.

slides.title: Who will I work with most?
slides.sub: Ask to meet them before you sign. The people beside you every day matter more than the pitch deck.

slides.title: What is the equity really worth?
slides.sub: A percentage on its own tells you little. Ask for the detail in writing:

slides.title: Ask all five before you sign.
